differences.title: 1. GOVERNANCE MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Managed by the Linux Foundation, ensuring community stewardship and open development practices without a single corporate owner.
differences.rightDesc: Developed and controlled by HashiCorp, with a strong corporate vision influencing roadmap and feature prioritization.

differences.title: 2. LICENSE & USAGE
differences.leftDesc: Uses Mozilla Public License 2.0, allowing broader commercial use and modification without strict limitations on SaaS offerings.
differences.rightDesc: Uses Business Source License 1.1, restricting certain SaaS use cases and requiring commercial agreements for extensive offerings.

differences.title: 3. STATE MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Focuses on established, generic remote state backends, promoting interoperability and avoiding vendor lock-in for state storage.
differences.rightDesc: Offers a wide array of optimized remote state backends, including proprietary HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP) features.

differences.title: 4. PROVIDER ECOSYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Leverages a vast, community-maintained registry of providers. Contributions are welcome and managed under open standards.
differences.rightDesc: Features providers primarily managed and tested by HashiCorp, offering a more curated but potentially less diverse selection.

differences.title: 5. EXTENSIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: Maintains a robust plugin architecture for custom providers and backends, emphasizing ease of contribution and integration.
differences.rightDesc: Utilizes a well-established plugin system allowing for custom resource management and extensions, deeply integrated with HashiCorp tooling.

differences.title: 6. CLI COMMANDS
differences.leftDesc: Aims for stable, predictable CLI commands inherited from Terraform, reducing learning curve and promoting consistent workflows.
differences.rightDesc: Has a familiar CLI but introduces new commands and options, reflecting ongoing development and feature additions by HashiCorp.

differences.title: 7. ROADMAP CONTROL
differences.leftDesc: Roadmap is shaped by community proposals and contributions via the OpenSSF, reflecting broad user needs and consensus.
differences.rightDesc: Roadmap is primarily driven by HashiCorp's strategic product direction and business objectives.
